skill.name: partner-directory-accounts
skill.description: Turn a public partner, integration, or marketplace directory into a deduplicated company list using Leadsets. Add company details, sources, and check dates where available.
skill.summary: Build a sourced company list from a public partner directory.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The backtick and reconnaissance matches are documentation, and the homepage and signup links do not trigger requests in the workflow. The Leadsets endpoint is an intended external dependency that processes the directory URL and company domains. The skill lacks explicit safeguards for untrusted directory content, spreadsheet exports, paid usage, and writes to connected accounts.

remediation.issue: Untrusted directory content enters the agent workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Treat directory text and tool results as data only. Extract only expected fields and ignore any instructions embedded in the results.

remediation.issue: Exported text can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas.
remediation.suggestion: Write untrusted fields as literal text in Sheets. Apply formula-safe CSV escaping and test exports with spreadsheet applications.

remediation.issue: Default runs can consume paid usage without approval.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose what goes to Leadsets and get approval for a fixed budget before scraping or enrichment. Stop at that budget, including during retries.

remediation.issue: Writes to Sheets or a CRM lack an explicit approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Preview the rows and confirm the workspace, destination, and whether records will be created or updated before writing.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Directory Content Reaches the Agent
semantic_findings.description: The workflow passes directory text and links into an agent that can make paid calls and write to connected systems. It does not tell the agent to ignore instructions in that content.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow explicitly processes public page content before tool calls and exports. No evidence of an embedded attack or successful execution was found in the supplied files.

semantic_findings.title: Spreadsheet Export Lacks Formula Safeguards
semantic_findings.description: The workflow retains directory-supplied names and categories and exports them to CSV or Sheets. A spreadsheet may interpret untrusted cell text as a formula instead of data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented workflow exports external text without specifying literal-cell handling or formula-safe CSV output. Actual behavior depends on the export connector and spreadsheet application.

semantic_findings.title: Paid Usage Is Not Tied to an Approved Budget
semantic_findings.description: The default allows enrichment for up to 200 domains and checks available quota instead of obtaining a spending limit. A run can consume paid usage that the user did not anticipate.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill defines a default account cap and usage charges. The scope step asks the agent to restate the plan but does not require approval of the paid usage.

semantic_findings.title: Connected Account Writes Lack Destination Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The user can opt for Sheets or a CRM instead of CSV. The workflow writes through the existing connection without verifying the workspace or confirming which records will change.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow restates the destination and then writes through the agent connection. The risk depends on the destination selected and the permissions of the configured account.

content.user_title: Build Account Lists from Partner Directories
content.value_statement: Public partner directories often omit the company details needed to compare accounts. This skill builds a deduplicated list and adds sourced company details where Leadsets finds a match.
actual_capabilities: Check Leadsets scrape units and enrichment quota before reading a public directory.
Extract partner names and listed categories, then deduplicate by root domain and exclude the directory owner.
Enrich companies with industry, employee count range, location, and technologies when available.
Keep sources and check dates, and label companies that Leadsets cannot match.
Mark companies against optional target criteria and deliver results as CSV or through a connected destination.
limitations: The workflow requires a Leadsets connection or API key. Directory scraping requires a paid plan with scrape units.
Private and paywalled directories are unsupported. Page structure and scrape depth can limit coverage.
This workflow returns company accounts, not individual contacts or email addresses.
Company details can be missing. The skill does not guess values for unmatched domains.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Small CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this public directory: [URL]. Check the Leadsets budget with me before scraping. Return up to 10 unique company accounts in a CSV.
prompt_templates.scenario: Collect a small sample from a single directory.

prompt_templates.title: Add Target Criteria
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [public URL] for US companies with 50 to 500 employees. Cap enrichment at 25 companies. Report nonmatching and unmatched rows separately in the CSV.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare a subset of companies against a target profile.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Quota-Limited Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Leadsets quota for [public URL]. Estimate usage and ask me to approve a budget. Stop at the approved limit and report what remains.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan a larger directory run without exceeding the approved usage.

prompt_templates.title: Stage a Sheets Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a sourced list from [public URL] using [target criteria]. Prepare Accounts, Not fit, and Not found tabs. Preview rows and confirm [workspace and sheet] before writing. Store directory text as literal cell values.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review account classifications before writing to a connected spreadsheet.

output_examples.input: Build a CSV from this public directory and mark US companies with 50 to 500 employees as a fit.
output: Illustrative result: 12 listings across two pages. After deduplication, 10 domains remained.
Leadsets matched eight domains and did not match two. Five matched companies fit the criteria, and three did not.
The CSV contains all 10 rows and includes sources and check dates for matched companies.

output_examples.input: Check whether this public app catalog includes partner listings before enriching any companies.
output_examples.output: Illustrative result: The first page showed only the directory owner's products. No partner list was found, so no company enrichment ran.

best_practices: Verify that the directory is public and ask for a usage estimate before approving paid calls.
Test one enrichment match and keep its source and check date before expanding the run.
Treat directory text as data, export it as literal text, and preview rows before approving a connected destination.
anti_patterns: Submitting login pages, private portals, or links that contain access tokens.
Treating missing company information as verified or hiding unmatched accounts.
Letting scraped text dictate tool actions or writing rows to a shared system without approval.

faq.question: What kinds of directories can I use?
faq.answer: Use public partner lists, integration directories, and app marketplaces. A directory must expose its partner names and links for extraction.

faq.question: Do I need a Leadsets account?
faq.answer: Yes. Connect Leadsets through MCP or provide a REST API key through your configured client. Scraping requires a paid plan with scrape units.

faq.question: What is sent to Leadsets?
faq.answer: Leadsets receives the directory URL for scraping and separate company domains for enrichment. Do not submit links that contain credentials or access tokens.

faq.question: Does the skill find contacts or emails?
faq.answer: No. It returns company accounts and available details such as industry, employee count range, location, and technologies.

faq.question: What happens when a company cannot be matched?
faq.answer: The account stays in the results with a not found status. The skill leaves missing company details blank instead of guessing.

faq.question: Where can I export the results?
faq.answer: CSV is the default. Sheets and CRM exports need a separate connection to the selected destination. Confirm the account and destination before writing.
